## Key Commands
<!-- These are the commands Claude should know about -->
- **Build**: `npm run build`
- **Dev**: `npm run dev`
- **Test**: `npm test`
- **Lint**: `npm run lint`
- **Format**: `npx prettier --write .`
- **Type check**: `npx tsc --noEmit`

## Code Conventions
- Use TypeScript strict mode; never use `any`
- Components in PascalCase, utilities in camelCase
- All API routes must validate input (e.g. with Zod)
- No `console.log` in production code — use a proper logger
- Prefer named exports over default exports
- Write JSDoc comments for all public functions

## Architecture
<!-- Describe your folder structure -->
- `/src/app` — App router pages (Next.js) or entry points
- `/src/components` — Reusable UI components
- `/src/lib` — Business logic, utilities, helpers
- `/src/types` — Shared TypeScript types and interfaces
- `/src/hooks` — Custom React hooks
- `/tests` — Test files mirroring src/ structure

## Git Conventions
- Commit messages follow Conventional Commits: `type(scope): subject`
- Types: `feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `docs`, `test`, `chore`, `style`
- Always create a feature branch; never commit directly to `main`
- PRs require passing tests before merge

## Error Handling
- Never silently catch errors — always log or re-throw
- API routes return proper HTTP status codes
- Use custom error classes for domain-specific errors

## Testing
- Write tests for all new features and bug fixes
- Use describe/it blocks with clear test names
- Mock external dependencies; never call real APIs in tests

## What NOT to Do
- Do NOT modify files in `/src/generated/` — these are auto-generated
- Do NOT install new dependencies without asking first
- Do NOT use `var` — always `const` or `let`
- Do NOT commit `.env` files or secrets
